items.title: The category of abelian sheaves on a site is abelian, with kernel and cokernel described by presheaf operations and sheafification
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects six facts about abelian sheaves on a site: that the category is abelian, that kernels agree with presheaf kernels, characterizations of injectivity, that cokernels are the sheafification of presheaf cokernels, characterizations of surjectivity, and the covering-wise criterion for exactness. The proof verifies the three hypotheses of the general adjunction criterion for the inclusion of abelian sheaves into abelian presheaves together with sheafification - additivity and adjointness, abelianness of the presheaf category with left exact sheafification, and the counit being an isomorphism - then reads off abelianness from that criterion (proof lines 373-408). The descriptions of kernel and cokernel follow from the proof of the cited criterion, and the remaining statements are then deduced from them (2) implies (3), (4) implies (5) by the description of sheafification, and (6) from (2) and (5)). H2: the verification of the criterion's hypotheses and the systematic deductions are the substance.
